data.long_meaning: She who brings about the creation and manifestation of something. The name Shrishti carries the meaning “Creation, Manifestation” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shrishti total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

The name serves as a reminder of our interconnectedness with the divine and encourages us to align our actions with the divine purpose.
